title: CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge
description:
CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge is a student-focused innovation hackathon where developers, designers, creators, and problem-solvers come together to build impactful solutions using technology. Unlike traditional hackathons that focus on a single domain, FutureForge embraces 
Open Innovation
, allowing participants to tackle real-world challenges across any field they are passionate about. Whether it's Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Education Technology, Sustainability, Productivity Tools, Mobile Applications, or something entirely unique, this is your platform to innovate. This hackathon is part of the 
CodeStorm 2026 Series
, an initiative dedicated to empowering students through hands-on learning, collaboration, and innovation. The event will be conducted completely online through our Discord community. Participation is free, and teams may consist of 
1–6 members
. Participants are encouraged to think boldly, experiment fearlessly, and build projects that create meaningful impact while showcasing technical excellence and creativity. CodeStorm is a student-led initiative dedicated to creating opportunities for young innovators, builders, and creators across India. title: Hack On Hills 8.0
description: Welcome to Hack on Hills 8.0, the flagship 48-hour hackathon hosted by the App Team, NIT Hamirpur. Over the years, Hack on Hills has grown into one of North India's largest student-run hackathons, bringing together thousands of developers, designers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts from across the country. This edition explores a defining shift in technology: the rise of autonomous agents. As AI systems evolve from tools that generate content to systems that can reason, plan, and execute tasks, we stand at the beginning of a new computing paradigm. Hack on Hills 8.0 invites participants to build products, platforms, and experiences that leverage this transformation to solve real-world problems. Whether you're building intelligent agents, decentralized applications, sustainable technology solutions, or entirely new ideas, this is your opportunity to turn ambitious concepts into working products. Build systems capable of reasoning, planning, decision-making, and autonomous execution. Develop decentralized applications, protocols, and infrastructure for the next generation of the internet. Create technology solutions addressing environmental, social, and community challenges. Explore bold ideas beyond predefined categories and build solutions that create meaningful impact. Shortlisting: Based on participant profiles and application review Finals: 48-hour in-person hackathon at NIT Hamirpur Participants will collaborate, prototype, and present their projects before a panel of industry experts, mentors, and judges. Hack on Hills 8.0 features a prize pool, sponsor challenges, and ecosystem bounties designed to recognize outstanding innovation across multiple domains. Prize details and partner tracks will be announced soon. With over 1,500+ registrations across previous editions, Hack on Hills continues to foster a community of builders who are passionate about technology, innovation, and problem-solving. title: Innosprint2.0
description:
What We Are:

D4 Community is proud to present an exciting 
one-day hackathon hosted at Chandigarh University
, bringing together undergraduate students, budding tech enthusiasts, aspiring innovators, and problem solvers under one roof. This hackathon is all about 
building ideas into working products using Vibe Coding and Antigravity
. Instead of spending hours worrying about every line of code, participants can focus on their ideas, creativity, experimentation, and problem-solving while using AI-powered development to bring their vision to life. Individual Participation Only
 — this is a solo hackathon. Every participant will ideate, build, and present their own project. Important Note:
 This is an 
individual participation hackathon
. On the registration platform, you may see an option to add up to 
4 participants
. Please ignore this and register as an individual participant. Due to platform restrictions, we are currently unable to change the maximum participant limit from 4 to 1. Our Mission:

Our mission is simple yet profound: to challenge participants to take an idea and turn it into something real within a single day. With 
Vibe Coding using Antigravity
, participants can experiment with AI-assisted development, iterate quickly, and transform their ideas into functional prototypes. The focus isn't on how much code you can write. It's about 
what you can imagine, how you solve problems, and what you can build. What to Expect:

Expect an action-packed 
one day of ideation, vibe coding, experimentation, and building
. You don't need to spend the entire day writing code line by line. Bring an idea. Bring your creativity. Bring your curiosity. Let Antigravity handle the building with you. Health & Wellness
 : Build solutions that make healthcare, wellness, fitness, or everyday well-being simpler, smarter, and more accessible. Education & Learning
 : Create products that improve the way people learn, teach, practice, collaborate, or access educational resources. Productivity & Lifestyle
 : Build tools that help people manage their time, work, tasks, routines, finances, or everyday activities more effectively. Social Impact
 : Use technology to address problems faced by communities, individuals, or society and create solutions that can make a meaningful difference. Business & Innovation
 : Build innovative products, platforms, or tools that solve business problems, improve existing experiences, or create new opportunities. Entertainment & Creativity
 : Build something fun, interactive, creative, or completely unexpected. Explore new ways to entertain, create, and engage. Open Theme
 : Have an idea that doesn't fit into any of the above? That's completely fine. Build 
anything you want
. If you can imagine it, you can build it. Why Join Us:

Join us to experience a completely different way of building products. Sharpen your problem-solving skills, experiment with 
Vibe Coding
, learn how to work with AI-assisted development, and turn an idea into a working prototype — 
all in a single day. Whether you're already familiar with AI-powered development or you're trying it for the first time, this hackathon is an opportunity to 
learn by building
. No team. No waiting for teammates. No complicated setup. Just you, your idea, Antigravity, and one day to build. Stay Tuned:

Stay tuned for updates, registration details, rules, judging criteria, and exciting announcements as we gear up for an unforgettable hackathon experience. Get ready to experiment with

title: GeNarrative Clash
description:
Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity: Kolkata's Ultimate Prompt Engineering Challenge Are you ready to redefine how stories are told, music is composed, and digital art is created? 
GeNarrative Clash
 is Kolkata's premier Prompt Engineering & AI Building Challenge, organized by the GeeksforGeeks Student Chapter at Techno India University. Don't worry if you are new to AI development! Before the live challenge kicks off, every participant gets access to an exclusive 
1-Hour Hands-On Masterclass on AI Development & API Integration
. Learn how to harness cutting-edge LLMs, query GenAI APIs, and leverage rapid prototyping tools so you can build a solid, production-ready product with confidence. Generative AI shouldn't replace human creators, it should supercharge them! 
GeNarrative Clash
 features an Open Track focused on building real-world solutions that assist, elevate, and support creative artists in their work. You are free to solve any real-world problem in the artistic or creative domain. title: TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon
description: AI agents are starting to act on their own: booking, negotiating, paying. The payment rails for that don't fully exist yet. This hackathon is about building the infrastructure and applications that let autonomous agents transact safely and instantly on-chain. TUM Blockchain Club has brought together 3,000+ builders, researchers and founders over the last four years, running Europe's largest student-led Web3 event. This year the hackathon sits inside TBC26: three days, two venues, one community, with the main conference and Bundesblock's Digital Assets Day running alongside. title: BIOS V2
description:
In a computer, the BIOS is the first thing that runs. Here, it's the first point of contact, where life and computation begin speaking to each other. BIOS V2 is CSED's flagship hackathon in collaboration with IEEE Student Chapter at Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala. It brings 300 shortlisted builders in 60 teams on campus for 48 hours of building, from 30 October to 1 November 2026. Safe Mode
: a guided but genuine build route for emerging builders. Overclocked Mode
: harder constraints, hidden evaluation and live technical defence, for advanced AI, systems and research work. Expect AI agents, coding tools and multimodal apps, with the freedom to compare and switch models as you build. All teams must be of 4 people and must have at least 1 female team member to qualify Worth of cash prizes, platform credits, tools and perks, with something for the teams that ship. A separate programme alongside the main event, with its own stage time and awards: Idea Lab:
 research, design and problem solving, ending in an evidence led proposal or low fidelity prototype and a live pitch. Build Lab:
 a supervised build ending in a working prototype and a technical defence. 📍 Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala

title: Winter of Code 2026
description: Winter of Code 2026 is an open-source contribution program designed to help students and developers get started with real-world software development and open-source collaboration. Participants will have the opportunity to explore open-source projects, contribute code, fix issues, improve documentation, and collaborate with project maintainers and fellow developers. The program focuses on learning by doing, encouraging participants to build practical development skills, understand real-world Git and GitHub workflows, and make meaningful contributions to the open-source community. Whether you are new to open source or already have development experience, Winter of Code 2026 provides an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow as a developer. title: Wild Bugs
description:

Wild Bugs
 — a 24-hour online hackathon where ideas are tested, solutions are built, and developers venture into the unpredictable wilderness of technology. Participants will be given

title: Srijan Setu
description:
Indo Global Colleges presents 
Srijan Setu
. It is a 
24-hour hackathon
 by 
Google Developer Groups on Campus: Indo Global College
, built around one simple idea — 
turning ideas into meaningful solutions. Inspired by the spirit of 
Spider-Man
, Srijan Setu is about using your skills, creativity, and technology with purpose. Just as every thread becomes stronger when it connects to another, great solutions are built when 
people, ideas, and technology come together. Bring your team of 
2–4 members
, choose a challenge from our innovation tracks, and spend 24 hours turning your idea into a working solution. Whether you're a developer, designer, problem-solver, or someone with an idea worth building, 
Srijan Setu is your space to experiment, collaborate, learn, and create. Explore challenges across:


• HealthTech

• EdTech

• AgriTech

• E-Commerce

• Open Theme You can choose the domain that interests you and build a solution that addresses a meaningful problem. It's about 
finding problems worth solving, building with purpose, learning from others, and connecting your ideas to real-world impact. •💡 Turn ideas into working solutions

•🤝 Collaborate with people from different backgrounds

•🧠 Learn through hands-on building

•🛠️ Experiment with modern technologies

•🌐 Connect with fellow builders and the developer community

•🎯 Take your solution from concept to prototype Use AI as a tool to think, build, experiment, and accelerate your development. Your solution should still reflect your team's understanding, creativity, and contribution.
